invariants.rationale: Method always returns an Iterator, guaranteed to be non-null by Collections.singletonList(...).iterator().
The returned Iterator is created from a singleton list, so it always has at least one element.
If there is a next element, it must not be null; createHandle.close() produces a WriteStatus object.
Partition path is used to construct the handle, and is likely required to be non-null.
The recordMap parameter is passed to the handle and should not be null for processing inserts.
